sites.asserts: 'PROGNOSIS: partly answered - two non-overlapping cohorts and 73 patients now give a crude magnitude ... and the same evidence says that magnitude is not independent of tumour size. What is missing there is a size-ADJUSTED analysis.'
sites.why_it_fails: The partial answer, and the framing that the only missing piece is a size-adjusted reanalysis, were licensed by the 73-patient pool. With Agaram alone at 23 patients and a descriptive p of 0.0672, a second source-verified event-count cohort is missing too. It also silently restates the withdrawn 73.

sites.asserts: 'the PROGNOSIS question, which now has a crude two-cohort magnitude'; 'the size-adjustment result printed inseparably from the magnitude it defeats'; 'the finding that the review literature's metastasis claim is unestablished in either direction once both count-bearing cohorts are in'.
sites.why_it_fails: All three rest on the pool. 'defeats' was independently withdrawn at manuscript s3.4 (the words defeater/confounded/absorbed are retired). 'Unestablished in either direction once both count-bearing cohorts are in' is a two-cohort finding; one cohort's non-significant crude tally establishes no null.
